summary: Net profit before tax for September 2026 was AUD 14,435 against a budget of AUD 5,083, ahead of budget by AUD 9,352. Revenue was AUD 21,700 above budget, mainly because Bayside Medical's stage 2 progress claim was invoiced in September at the client's request; higher materials, the annual accounts and tax fee and new equipment hire partly offset this.
author: reviewer-approved reference

items.text: Fitout contract revenue was AUD 182,400 against a budget of AUD 160,000, a favourable variance of AUD 22,400 (14.0%). Bayside Medical Centre asked for its stage 2 progress claim to be issued in September rather than October, so INV-1042 for AUD 60,000 was billed this month. October revenue will be correspondingly lower than budget.

drivers.description: Bayside Medical stage 2 progress claim invoiced in September instead of October

items.text: Materials were AUD 61,850 against a budget of AUD 52,000, an unfavourable variance of AUD 9,850 (18.9%). Two things drove this: AUD 19,850 of laminate and hardware bought for the Bayside Medical stage 2 job, which moved into September with the revenue (TC-88801), and Timberco's 8% price increase on hardwood and board from 1 September, reflected in the AUD 28,400 general stock invoice (TC-88790).

drivers.description: Materials for Bayside Medical stage 2 bought in September
Timberco 8% price increase on hardwood and board

items.text: Subcontractor costs were AUD 28,300 against a budget of AUD 34,000, a favourable variance of AUD 5,700 (16.8%). The Coastal Dental electrical rough-in moved to 6 October at the builder's request, so that work will be billed in October. This is a timing difference rather than a saving.

drivers.description: Coastal Dental electrical rough-in deferred to October

follow_up: Please confirm the value of the Coastal Dental rough-in so October can be forecast.

items.text: Administration and professional fees were AUD 8,198 against a budget of AUD 3,850, an unfavourable variance of AUD 4,348 (112.9%). This is almost entirely the AUD 4,300 accrual for the FY2026 financial statements and tax return from Pinnacle Audit & Advisory (invoice PA-7781, received in October). It is an annual cost and should not recur next month.

drivers.description: FY2026 financial statements and tax return fee accrued

items.text: Other operating expenses were AUD 4,600 against a nil budget. This is scissor lift and access equipment hire for the Bayside Medical job (Hire-It Equipment, HI-5521), coded to a new Equipment Hire account opened in September. Because it relates to a specific job, we suggest coding it to cost of sales.

drivers.description: Equipment hire for the Bayside Medical job

follow_up: Should equipment hire for specific jobs be coded to cost of sales?
